paragraphs.en: We are your essential toolkit for computer vision. From data loading to real-time zone counting, we provide the building blocks so you can focus on building applications around your models. 🤝
paragraphs.zh: 我们是您计算机视觉领域不可或缺的工具箱。 从数据加载到实时区域计数，我们提供基础构建模块，让您能够专注于围绕自己的模型构建应用。🤝

sents.en: We are your essential toolkit for computer vision.

paragraphs.en: Pip install the supervision package in a Python>=3.10 environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Python>=3.10 环境中使用 pip 安装 supervision 包。

paragraphs.en: pip install supervision Read more about conda, mamba, and installing from source in our guide .
paragraphs.zh: pip install supervision 了解更多关于 conda、mamba 以及从源码安装的信息，请参阅我们的指南。

paragraphs.en: Supervision was designed to be model agnostic. Just plug in any classification, detection, or segmentation model. For your convenience, we have created connectors for the most popular libraries like Ultralytics, Transformers, MMDetection, or Inference. Other integrations, like rfdetr , already return sv.Detections directly.
paragraphs.zh: Supervision 的设计是与模型无关的。 只需接入任何分类、检测或分割模型即可。 为方便起见，我们为最流行的库（如 Ultralytics、Transformers、MMDetection 或 Inference）创建了连接器。 其他集成（如 rfdetr）则已经直接返回 sv.Detections。

paragraphs.en: Install the optional dependencies for this example with pip install pillow rfdetr .
paragraphs.zh: 使用 pip install pillow rfdetr 安装本示例的可选依赖项。

paragraphs.en: import supervision as sv from PIL import Image from rfdetr import RFDETRSmall image = Image . open ( "path/to/image.jpg" ) model = RFDETRSmall () detections = model . predict ( image , threshold = 0.5 ) len ( detections ) # 5 👉 more model connectors inference
paragraphs.zh: import supervision as sv from PIL import Image from rfdetr import RFDETRSmall image = Image . open ( "path/to/image.jpg" ) model = RFDETRSmall () detections = model . predict ( image , threshold = 0.5 ) len ( detections ) # 5 👉 更多模型连接器推理

paragraphs.en: Running with Inference requires a Roboflow API KEY .
paragraphs.zh: 运行 Inference 需要 Roboflow API 密钥（API KEY）。

paragraphs.en: import supervision as sv from PIL import Image from inference import get_model image = Image . open ( "path/to/image.jpg" ) model = get_model ( model_id = "rfdetr-small" , api_key = "ROBOFLOW_API_KEY" ) result = model . infer ( image )[ 0 ] detections = sv . Detections . from_inference ( result ) len ( detections ) # 5 Annotators Supervision offers a wide range of highly customizable annotators , allowing you to compose the perfect visualization for your use case.
paragraphs.zh: import supervision as sv from PIL import Image from inference import get_model image = Image . open ( "path/to/image.jpg" ) model = get_model ( model_id = "rfdetr-small" , api_key = "ROBOFLOW_API_KEY" ) result = model . infer ( image )[ 0 ] detections = sv . Detections . from_inference ( result ) len ( detections ) # 5 标注器 Supervision 提供了大量高度可定制的标注器，让你能够为你的使用场景组合出完美的可视化效果。
